newsitem.title: JAPAN: India brings forward January crude tender deadline.
newsitem.headline: India brings forward January crude tender deadline.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has brought forward the closing and validity dates of a tender to buy January crude oil, traders said on Thursday.
The IOC initially set the closing date of the tender at November 28 and the validity at November 29.
But, the dates have been brought forward by one day to November 27 and 28 respectively, traders said.
The tender, which sought one million barrels of crude, was issued earlier in November.
Traders said they were not given an explanation for the change in dates.
The tender covers a wide range of crude oil, including Gulf grades, Asian regional crudes and North Sea crudes.
